React Component library | shadcn-chat: Elevate Your Next.js Projects with Customizable and Reusable Chat Components

Embark on a journey of seamless communication with shadcn-chat—a customizable and reusable chat component meticulously crafted on the foundations of Next.js, shadcn, and Framer Motion. Tailored for effortless integration, shadcn-chat brings a new level of flexibility to your Next.js projects.

shadcn-chat introduces a chat component designed with customization in mind. Developers have the power to adapt it to their specific project requirements—whether it's tweaking the aesthetics or enhancing functionality, shadcn-chat molds to your needs.
